name: message-scroller
title: Message Scroller
description: Scroll position for a chat transcript: follows a streamed reply while the reader is at the end, lets go on a manual scroll, glides a new user turn to the top of the view with the reply growing under it, and shows a button back to the latest message. Holds no messages and no chat state.
docs: Docs & live demo: https://www.fluidfunctionalism.com/docs/input-message. Craft notes, the scroll and motion decisions to keep when you change it: https://github.com/mickadesign/fluid-functionalism/blob/main/skills/fluid-functionalism/references/craft.md#input-message.
